title: Friday 090501
wodRaw:
"**Tabata Something Else**"  
  
Complete 32 intervals of 20 seconds of work followed by ten seconds of rest where the first 8 intervals are pull-ups, the second 8 are push-ups, the third 8 intervals are sit-ups, and finally, the last 8 intervals are squats. There is no rest between exercises.  
  
Post total reps from all 32 intervals to comments.  
  
Compare to [081130](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/004332.html).
otherRaw: [American Society of Exercise Physiologists Presentation](http://journal.crossfit.com/2009/04/asep-lecture.tpl) by Greg Glassman, [CrossFit Journal](http://journal.crossfit.com)

Thank you to the [26 affiliates and 45 trainers](http://www.crossfitrrg.com/index#contributors) who have joined up with the [CrossFit Risk Retention Group](http://www.crossfitrrg.com) this week in support of our community and profession.

title: Tuesday 090505
wodRaw:
Ten rounds for time of:  
3 Weighted Pull-ups, 45 pounds  
5 Strict Pull-ups  
7 Kipping Pull-up  
  
For weighted pull-ups place a 45 pound dumbbell between the legs above crossed ankles and jettison the dumbbell after third rep and continue with strict pull-ups and then the kipping pull-ups. Coming off the bar or going to ground constitutes termination of a set.  
  
Post time and number of sets to completion.  
  
Compare to [090319](http://www.crossfit.com/mt-archive2/004566.html).
